description: Check whether Shani Sade Sati or Dhaiya (Saturn's transit over the natal Moon) is running for a person, which phase, its dates, and the full list of Sade Sati and Dhaiya windows across about 30 years around now. Based on the Moon sign; birth time is needed only when the Moon changed sign on the birth date.

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.
